The '''Bronzan Concourse''' was located in the [[Old Bronzan]] of [[Efavan/Legends|Efavan]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. It was one of the city's most prominent malls.
